notes: Void Drifter - A complete top-down action roguelike where players survive 10 sectors of escalating void entities. Features: deterministic fixed-timestep simulation with delta-time, 4 distinct enemy types with unique behaviors (drifter, stalker, anchor, void_walker), energy management system (shards for energy, health regen above 50% energy), void dash with invincibility frames and offensive capability, procedural but seeded level generation, full particle system (800 particles), screen shake, hit-stop, synthesized Web Audio API sound effects and procedural ambient music, keyboard/mouse and touch controls, pause on blur, localStorage persistence for best score/sector, WCAG AA contrast, reduced-motion support, semantic HTML with ARIA labels. Runs from single index.html with no build step.
